values_observed: high | med | medium | low (any other/unmapped string falls through .get(s,1.0) default, i.e. behaves as med)

geometric_term: close_z = plane_z + close_depth_frac*(obj_top_z-plane_z); then clamped to [plane_z+0.025, obj_top_z-0.025]

geometric_term: cage_gap_m = clip(part_width_m + clearance, APERTURE_MIN_M=0.030, APERTURE_MAX_M=0.125) (metres, direct sum then hard clamp)

field: part_width_m (perception input, not a VLM constraint field)
values_observed: computed per-grasp from the point cloud slab around the closing axis; NaN if fewer than 60 points fall in the slab
transformation: gap = clip(part_width_m + clearance, APERTURE_MIN_M=0.030, APERTURE_MAX_M=0.125); cage_motor_rad = gap_to_motor(gap, gap_map): piecewise-linear interpolation over the measured (motor_rad,gap_m) points from gripper_gap_map.csv sorted by gap, clamped to the map's endpoints outside its range, or the linear fit (gap-0.0559)/0.064 if gap_map is empty/missing; width_gate_ok = 1 if part_width_m+clearance<=APERTURE_MAX_M else 0
geometric_term: gap_m = part_width_m + clearance_m (linear sum, metres); motor_rad = interpolation of measured gripper_gap_map.csv points (or the 0.064 m/rad linear fit, 0-rad intercept 0.0559 m, dated 14 Jul in the code comment)

values_observed: deviation of a single grasp's measured part_width_m from the scene median part_width across all grasps
closure_parameter: ok, note (QC flag, not a closure parameter)
transformation: if isfinite(w_med) and w_med>0 and abs(w-w_med)/w_med > MED_TOL(0.30): ok=0, note="WIDTH ARTIFACT: {w}mm vs scene median {w_med}mm"

field: plane_z / obj_top_z (perception, scene geometry -- not a VLM constraint field)
values_observed: plane_z = mode of a 60-bin local height histogram near the affordance/grasp centroid; obj_top_z = 98th percentile of local points above plane_z+0.008 (NaN if fewer than 50 such points)
transformation: h = obj_top_z - plane_z; z = plane_z + close_depth_frac*h; z clamped to [plane_z+0.025, obj_top_z-0.025]
geometric_term: linear interpolation along object height by close_depth_frac, then a hard 0.025 m geometric clamp from each end of the object's height range

field: force_level (derived tier, not a raw VLM field)
transformation: FORCE_LEVELS lookup: gentle->(effort=0.15, hold_margin=0.000), standard->(effort=0.30, hold_margin=0.008), firm->(effort=0.50, hold_margin=0.016)
geometric_term: hold_margin_rad is documented (module comment only, not computed in code) as ~MM_PER_RAD=0.064 m/rad, i.e. standard's 0.008 rad hold margin corresponds to ~0.6 mm of extra squeeze past detected contact
